BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Commerce & Labor.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Addressing the time period for workers to recover wages under prevailing wage laws.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the time period for workers to recover wages under prevailing wage laws; and amending RCW 39.12.015.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 39.12.015 and 1965 ex.s. c 133 s 2 are each amended to read as follows:Industrial statistician to make determinations of prevailing rate.
BillSection.P: (1) All determinations of the prevailing rate of wage shall be made by the industrial statistician of the department of labor and industries.

P.TextRun: (2) The time period for recovery of any wages owed to a worker affected by the determination is tolled until the prevailing wage determination is final.
